correctness.rationale: The argument follows from the standard Fibonacci valuation lift v_q(F_m)=e_q+v_q(m/z(q)) when z(q)|m. Since z(q)|P=pi(q) and q does not divide P for q!=5, P/z(q) is a unit modulo every q to the power s; hence one residue class of the progression parameter modulo q to the power s gives density q to the power -s. A fresh q=3 check reproduced densities 1, 1/3, and approximately 1/9 for a=1,2,3. The totient witness deduction is then immediate from the prime-factor formula for phi.
